name: ans-music
description: ANS Music — Backend Node.js (Express+TS, :4039/api) + Frontend React (Vite). Tách rời qua API key.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
